description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each card in your library.
Cast The Legend of Kyoshi by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When The Legend of Kyoshi enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, thus drawing your library.

uses.name: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi
